messages:
maria: Quick callout from the postmortem thread 9999999999999 9Can we list concrete owners and dates for the metering reconciliation + invoice correction work?

kevin: I can take the corrected token export + reconciliation. Short summary: consumer commit stalls during GC/rebalance windows caused about ~10-15% of tokens to be omitted for ~2.5h on 2026-03-18.

lina: Billing ops here 999999999999We currently have 52 potentially impacted invoices flagged. Need the final per-account delta before issuing credits.

priyanka: I'll own the ingestion-side mitigation (consumer-level). Plan: add safer commit backoff + temporary throttle of commit workers. Will roll a canary and monitor. ETA canary -> 2026-03-24, full roll -> 2026-03-25 if stable.

kevin: For the backfill I'll reprocess raw event files from the archival S3 path and regenerate metering rows. Proposed commands (dry-run then run):

```
# dry-run to validate mapping
./bin/meter-reprocess --input s3://redwood-archive/events/2026-03-18/ --validate-only
# full reprocess
./bin/meter-reprocess --input s3://redwood-archive/events/2026-03-18/ --output s3://redwood-metering/reconciled/2026-03-18/
```

kevin: Backfill window I expect: start 2026-03-26, finish 2026-03-27 (cluster booking dependent). Will produce a delta CSV and a checksumed artifact.

lina: CSV format we need: account_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, new_tokens, token_delta, rate_per_token, credit_amount. If you can attach sample rows to the ticket that helps QA.

priyanka: For monitoring I'll add two things: 1) consumer-lag alert when lag > 4000 for 10m 2) commit-latency alert when p95 commit > 0.7s for 3 windows. Also dashboard panels for per-partition lag and recent rebalance events. JIRA will include dashboard links.

maria: Ok owners proposed: reconciliation/export (kevin), billing credits (lina), consumer fix + alerts (priyanka), external comms (I'll coordinate). Does that mapping work?

kevin: Works for me. I'll create INFRA-9922 for the reprocess and attach logs/diff.

lina: I'll open BILL-4609 for the credit batch and include finance audit fields.

priyanka: I'll create MTR-2050 for metrics/alerts and INFRA-9923 for the commit-worker change if we need a separate infra ticket.

maria: Communications 9999999999999I'll draft an external note and support FAQ. Target initial outreach to affected customers by 2026-03-29 with follow-up after credits post. JIRA COMM-1110 for comms.

maria: Recurring incident pattern note: we saw smaller, similar consumer lag episodes on 2025-11-11 and 2026-01-06. Suggest adding a quarterly ingestion SLO review and retaining consumer lag traces for 90 days. Propose recurring meeting.

kevin: +1. Also propose adding a step in the billing workflow: only mark reconciliation complete after finance ack (automated signal) so credits aren't sent prematurely.

lina: Agreed 9999999999Will add a gating flag to BILL-4609 and require the reconciliation artifact link.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started by priyanka on infra-canary-7. Status: rolling.

priyanka: Canary telemetry looks good so far 999999p95 commit latency down ~40%. I'll wait 45m then decide on progressive rollout.

kevin: Estimated impact summary I'll add to INFRA-9922: affected_accounts=52, estimated_token_delta_total=9.8e8, note="commit stalls during GC/rebalance".

maria: Timeline recap: reprocess complete by 2026-03-27 (kevin), corrected CSV to billing by 2026-03-27-28 (kevin->lina), credits drafted by 2026-03-30 (lina), customer outreach by 2026-03-29 (maria), monitoring + alerts live by 2026-03-25 (priyanka). Flag any slips here.

kevin: ACK 99999I'll post artifacts to INFRA-9922 and ping billing when CSV is ready.

lina: ACK. I'll prepare credit memo templates for audit and draft support replies.

priyanka: ACK. I'll update tickets with dashboard links and canary logs.

maria: Thanks all 99999closing out here; I'll update the postmortem follow-up doc and create the recurring review invite. :thumbsup:
